61370-a-fortnight-at-the-front.title: A Fortnight At The Front
61370-a-fortnight-at-the-front.creator: Unknown
61370-a-fortnight-at-the-front.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. I know that the Lord Mayor of Birmingham, who spent nearly a week with me, feels this as warmly as myself, and it shows the wonderful calm of an Englishman that we were both so kindly treated, though we added in no way to the happiness or usefulness of anybody.

arxiv-1405-4070.title: Self-referencing cellular automata: A model of the evolution of information control in biological systems
arxiv-1405-4070.creator: Theodore P. Pavlic, Alyssa M. Adams, Paul C. W. Davies, Sara Imari Walker Arizona State University, Tempe, AZ 85287 tpavlic@asu.edu
arxiv-1405-4070.description: Abstract Cellular automata have been useful artificial models for exploring how relatively simple rules combined with spatial memory can give rise to complex emergent patterns. Moreover, studying the dynamics of how rules emerge under artificial selection for function has recently become a powerful tool for understanding how evolution can innovate within its genetic rule space.

arxiv-1603-08160.title: A Model of Charge Transfer Excitons: Diffusion, Spin Dynamics, and Magnetic Field Effects
arxiv-1603-08160.creator: Chee Kong Lee, Liang Shi, Adam P. Willard
arxiv-1603-08160.description: Abstract In this letter we explore how the microscopic dynamics of charge transfer (CT) excitons are influenced by the presence of an external magnetic field in disordered molecular semiconductors. This influence is driven by the dynamic interplay between the spin and spatial degrees of freedom of the electron-hole pair.

arxiv-1908-11614.title: Designing with Data: A Case Study
arxiv-1908-11614.creator: Teresa Castle-Green Stuart Reeves Joel E. Fischer Boriana Koleva
arxiv-1908-11614.description: Abstract . As the Internet of Things continues to take hold in the commercial world, the teams designing these new technologies are constantly evolving and turning their hand to uncharted territory. This is especially key within the field of secondary service design as businesses attempt to utilize and find value in the sensor data being produced by connected products.

arxiv-2402-00001.title: Using binary string to prove the Collatz conjecture
arxiv-2402-00001.creator: Ji she Feng
arxiv-2402-00001.description: Abstract . We introduce a full binary directed tree structure to represent the set of natural numbers, further categorizing them into three distinct subsets: pure odd numbers, pure even numbers, and mixed numbers. We adopt a binary string representation for natural numbers and elaborate on the composite methodology encompassing odd- and even-number functions.

arxiv-2403-09469.title: Unexpected subgroup schemes of PGL 2 , k \operatorname{PGL}_{2,k} in characteristic 2 2
arxiv-2403-09469.creator: Bianca Gouthier, Dajano Tossici
arxiv-2403-09469.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Bianca Gouthier, Dajano Tossici. If the characteristic of a field k k is odd any infinitesimal group scheme of PGL 2 , k \operatorname{PGL}_{2,k} lifts to SL 2 , k \operatorname{SL}_{2,k} . In this paper, we prove that this is not true in characteristic 2 2 and we give a complete description, up to isomorphism, of infinitesimal unipotent subgroup schemes of PGL 2 , k \operatorname{PGL}_{2,k} . Also, the infinitesimal trigonalizable case is considered.

arxiv-2409-07700.title: Disturbance-Robust Backup Control Barrier Functions: Safety Under Uncertain Dynamics
arxiv-2409-07700.creator: David E.J. van Wijk, Samuel Coogan, Tamas G. Molnar, Manoranjan Majji, Kerianne L. Hobbs
arxiv-2409-07700.description: Abstract Obtaining a controlled invariant set is crucial for safety-critical control with control barrier functions (CBFs) but is non-trivial for complex nonlinear systems and constraints. Backup control barrier functions allow such sets to be constructed online in a computationally tractable manner by examining the evolution (or flow) of the system under a known backup control law.

arxiv-2411-12802.title: An exceptionally simple family of Orthosymplectic 3d 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}=4 rank − 0 \text{rank}\scriptsize{-}0 SCFTs
arxiv-2411-12802.creator: Zhenghao Zhong
arxiv-2411-12802.description: Abstract We look at a family of 3d 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}=4 rank − 0 \text{rank}\scriptsize{-}0 orthosymplectic quiver gauge theories. We define a superconformal field theory (SCFT) to be rank − 0 \text{rank}\scriptsize{-}0 if either the Higgs branch or Coulomb branch is trivial.

arxiv-2412-16513.title: Bayesian constraints on covariant density functional equations of state of compact stars with new NICER mass-radius measurements
arxiv-2412-16513.creator: Jia-Jie Li, Yu Tian, Armen Sedrakian
arxiv-2412-16513.description: Abstract Recent advancements in astrophysical observations of compact stars, particularly the new and updated NICER constraints, have provided mass-radius ( M M - R R ) data for pulsars spanning masses from 1 to 2 ​ M ⊙ 2\,M_{\odot} . These data offer a unique opportunity to test modern theories of dense matter using multi-messenger constraints.

arxiv-2501-14297.title: Cylindrically confined hydrogen atom in magnetic field: variational cut-off factor
arxiv-2501-14297.creator: A. N. Mendoza Tavera, H. Olivares-Pilón, M. Rodríguez-Arcos, A. M. Escobar-Ruiz
arxiv-2501-14297.description: Abstract In the present study, we consider the hydrogen atom confined within an impenetrable infinite cylindrical cavity of radius ρ 0 \rho_{0} in the presence of a constant magnetic field 𝐁 = B ​ 𝐳 ^ {\bf B}=B\,\hat{\bf z} oriented along the main cylinder’s axis.

arxiv-2508-18335.title: Morse functions constructed by random walks
arxiv-2508-18335.creator: Boldizsár Kalmár
arxiv-2508-18335.description: Abstract . We construct random Morse functions on surfaces by random walk and compute related distributions. We study the space of Morse functions through these random variables. We consider subspaces characterized by the surfaces with boundary obtained by cutting the closed domain surface of the Morse function at the levels of regular values.

arxiv-2509-07903.title: Optimal Surfaces for Turbulent Circulation Statistics
arxiv-2509-07903.creator: L. Moriconi
arxiv-2509-07903.description: Abstract We put forward a novel formulation of the vortex gas model of turbulent circulation statistics to address the challenging case of nonplanar circulation contours. Relying upon a field-theoretical description, statistical moments of the circulation turn out to be functionally dependent on specific optimal surfaces bounded by the circulation loops.

arxiv-2510-23055.title: From Online User Feedback to Requirements: Evaluating Large Language Models for Classification and Specification Tasks
arxiv-2510-23055.creator: Manjeshwar Aniruddh Mallya, Alessio Ferrari, Mohammad Amin Zadenoori, Jacek Dąbrowski
arxiv-2510-23055.description: Abstract [Context and Motivation] Online user feedback provides valuable information to support requirements engineering (RE). However, analysing online user feedback is challenging due to its large volume and noise. Large language models (LLMs) show strong potential to automate this process and outperform previous techniques. They can also enable new tasks, such as generating requirements specifications.

arxiv-2602-16471.title: Monte Carlo study of the classical antiferromagnetic J 1 J_{1} - J 2 J_{2} - J 3 J_{3} Heisenberg model on a simple cubic lattice
arxiv-2602-16471.creator: A.N. Ignatenko, S.V. Streltsov, V.Yu. Irkhin
arxiv-2602-16471.description: Abstract An extensive Monte Carlo study of the classical Heisenberg model on a simple cubic lattice with antiferromagnetic exchange interactions J n J_{n} between the first, second, and third neighbors is performed in a broad region of J 2 / J 1 J_{2}/J_{1} , J 3 / J 1 J_{3}/J_{1} ratios, and temperature.

europmc-pmc3702519.title: Measuring myeloperoxidase activity in biological samples.
europmc-pmc3702519.creator: Pulli B, Ali M, Forghani R, Schob S, Hsieh KL, Wojtkiewicz G, Linnoila JJ, Chen JW.
europmc-pmc3702519.description: Background Enzymatic activity measurements of the highly oxidative enzyme myeloperoxidase (MPO), which is implicated in many diseases, are widely used in the literature, but often suffer from nonspecificity and lack of uniformity. Thus, validation and standardization are needed

pmc-10617575.title: Chronic GCPII (glutamate‐carboxypeptidase‐II) inhibition reduces pT217Tau levels in the entorhinal and dorsolateral prefrontal cortices of aged macaques
pmc-10617575.creator: Shveta Bathla, Dibyadeep Datta, Feng Liang, Nicolas Barthelemy, Robyn Wiseman, Barbara S Slusher, Jennifer Asher, Caroline Zeiss, Dil Ekanayake‐Alper, Daniel Holden, Gordon Terwilliger, Alvaro Duque, Jon Arellano, Christopher van Dyck, Randall J Bateman, Zhongcong Xie, Angus C Nairn, Amy F T Arnsten
pmc-10617575.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionCurrent approaches for treating sporadic Alzheimer's disease (sAD) focus on removal of amyloid beta 1‐42 (Aβ1‐42) or phosphorylated tau, but additional strategies are needed to reduce neuropathology at earlier stages prior to neuronal damage. Longstanding data show that calcium dysregulation is a key etiological factor in sAD, and the cortical neurons most vulnerable to tau pathology show magnified calcium signaling, for example in dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) and entorhinal cortex (ERC).

pmc-11337849.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and practices of government workers on zoonotic parasites in pet animals: a study in Central Gondar Zone, Ethiopia
pmc-11337849.creator: Adanie Delie, Gashaw Getaneh Dagnaw, Abebe Tesfaye Gessese, Haileyesus Dejene
pmc-11337849.description: BackgroundParasitic zoonoses are infections transmitted between vertebrate animals and humans, posing serious public health risks and significant economic consequences. The study aimed at assessing government workers' knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding zoonotic parasites of pet animals in Ethiopia's central Gondar zone.

pmc-11437088.title: Deep-learning model accurately classifies multi-label lung ultrasound findings, enhancing diagnostic accuracy and inter-reader agreement
pmc-11437088.creator: Daeeon Hong, Hyewon Choi, Wonju Hong, Yisak Kim, Tae Jung Kim, Jinwook Choi, Sang-Bae Ko, Chang Min Park
pmc-11437088.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Despite the increasing use of lung ultrasound (LUS) in the evaluation of respiratory disease, operators’ competence constrains its effectiveness. We developed a deep-learning (DL) model for multi-label classification using LUS and validated its performance and efficacy on inter-reader variability. We retrospectively collected LUS and labeled as normal, B-line, consolidation, and effusion from patients undergoing thoracentesis at a tertiary institution between January 2018 and January 2022.

pmc-11862842.title: Experimental comparative study of Two-dimensional and Three-dimensional CT reconstruction in detecting maxillofacial fractures at Mzuzu Central Hospital, Malawi
pmc-11862842.creator: Tianze Sun, Blessed Kondowe, Brave Kadoko Nyirenda, Jun Liu, Hui Zhang, Jin Shang
pmc-11862842.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this study is to compare the diagnostic value of two-dimensional (2D) CT and three-dimensional (3D) CT reconstruction techniques in detecting maxillofacial fractures in patients at Mzuzu Central Hospital (MCH).Methods67 maxillofacial trauma patients admitted to Mzuzu Central Hospital from Jan to Sep 2024 underwent multi-slice spiral CT (MSCT) scanning. Images were post-processed using 2D and 3D reconstruction techniques.

pmc-12649282.title: In Vitro and In Vivo Evaluation of Autochthonous Probiotics and Their Effects on the Mucosal Health of Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus)
pmc-12649282.creator: Sherilyn T. Abarra, Sahya Maulu, Sheu G. Odu-Onikosi, Taofik A. Momoh, Benjamin Eynon, Matthew Emery, Mark Rawling, Daniel L. Merrifield
pmc-12649282.description: Simple SummaryProbiotics, which are beneficial microbes that support digestion and strengthen natural defences, offer a promising approach to support sustainable fish farming. In this study, bacteria naturally found in the gut of Nile tilapia were investigated to see if they could serve as probiotics. Two strains of bacteria were identified that could inhibit relevant fish pathogens and produce digestive enzymes.

pmc-13089551.title: Socioeconomic inequalities in life expectancy within and between native-born and foreign-born populations: a comparative study of 10 European countries
pmc-13089551.creator: Su Yeon Jang, Frank J van Lenthe, Mikko Myrskylä, Anna Oksuzyan, Silvia Loi, Matthias Bopp, Henrik Brønnum-Hansen, Patrick Deboosere, Ramunė Kalėdienė, Mall Leinsalu, Pekka Martikainen, Olof M Östergren, Sophie Psihoda, Enrique Regidor, Nicolás Zengarini, Wilma J Nusselder
pmc-13089551.description: BackgroundForeign-born residents in high-income countries often outlive the native-born population, but it remains unclear how this advantage varies across countries and socioeconomic groups. We aimed to assess socioeconomic inequalities in the life expectancy advantage of foreign-born populations across 10 European countries.

pmc-13106131.title: What is the impact of the virome and mycobiome on female reproductive tract health? A systematic scoping review
pmc-13106131.creator: Ying Liu, Xingya Liao, Qimeng Chen, Hongyan Wang, Hualei Dai
pmc-13106131.description: BackgroundTraditional research on the female reproductive tract (FRT) microbiome has focused on the dominance of bacteria, particularly Lactobacillus, as a marker of health. This bacteriocentric paradigm, however, cannot fully explain clinical enigmas like the high recurrence of bacterial vaginosis (BV) or the persistence of HPV infection.

pmc-13123783.title: Bioactive luting cements on the adhesive interface of fiber post and root dentin: a comparative study of bond strength, water interaction, and enzymatic degradation
pmc-13123783.creator: Tiago Carvalho dos Santos, Giovanna Speranza Zabeu, Ana Carolina Almeida Lima, Mylena Proença Costa, Marcela Rocha Carrilho, Rafael Francisco Lia Mondelli, Linda Wang
pmc-13123783.description: Innovative self-etching dental cements have been considered a versatile material with recent formulations incorporating bioactive additives. Objective This study analyzed the role of these ingredients in systems used for luting intracanal posts.Methodology Bond strength (BS), water sorption (WS), water solubility (WSB), and in situ zymography (IZ) were assessed.

pmc-13371481.title: DMAMCL induces ferroptosis in neuroblastoma by targeting HMOX1 in MYCN-amplified subtypes whereas targeting STEAP3 in MYCN-nonamplified subtypes
pmc-13371481.creator: Yifan Ma, Simeng Zhang, Dongyang Zhang, Zhongyan Hua, Zhijie Li
pmc-13371481.description: ObjectivesNeuroblastoma (NB) is a common pediatric extracranial solid tumor. Dimethylaminomicheliolide (DMAMCL), a prodrug of Micheliolide (MCL), shows antitumor activity against NB, but its mechanisms remain unclear. This study investigated the antitumor mechanisms of DMAMCL in NB.MethodsKey pathways/genes were identified by RNA-seq and ferroptosis PCR array. Ferroptosis was confirmed by indicators.

pmc-13495161.creator: Raffaele Badolato, Viola Ceconi, Roberto Bellu’, Eugenio Baraldi, Chiara Azzari, Renato Cutrera, Fabio Midulla, Roberto Bernardini, Domenico Cipolla, Daniela Concolino, Alessandro Consolaro, Elisabetta Cortis, Antonio Cualbu, Marisa D’Andrea, Grazia Dinnella, Simonetta Fain, Enrico Felici, Santina Gaggiano, Paola Giordano, Alfredo Guarino, Lorenzo Iughetti, Eustachio Lapacciana, Angelo Pietrobelli, Guido Pennoni, Ermanno Ruffini, Camilla Gizzi, Massimo Agosti, Rino Agostiniani, ITARSV-Task-force

pmc-13599571.title: What predicts adolescents’ mathematics anxiety in the Middle East and North Africa? An interpretable machine learning analysis of six Arab education systems in PISA 2022
pmc-13599571.creator: Omar Allohibi
pmc-13599571.description: IntroductionMathematics anxiety is among the most consequential affective barriers to mathematics learning, yet large-scale evidence from the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) remains scarce. Existing research on the region rarely moves beyond linear models, and no study has applied interpretable machine learning (ML) to identify which psychological, instructional, and contextual factors jointly predict mathematics anxiety among Arab adolescents.

pmc-13602769.title: ROS-responsive small-molecule self-assembled nanocarrier-integrated hydrogels for ulcerative colitis treatment
pmc-13602769.creator: Chen Zhang, Shanying Han, Lei Yang, Wenya Weng, Panpan Wei, Yingping Xiao, Qingfei Zhang, Ruiyao Zhou
pmc-13602769.description: Ulcerative colitis (UC) has a multifactorial pathogenesis, driven primarily by excessive accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS), aberrant inflammatory activation, intestinal barrier dysfunction, and intestinal microbiota dysbiosis. Conventional therapies face challenges including poor targeting specificity, low delivery efficiency, insufficient barrier repair, and limited microbiota modulation.
